messages:
Olivia: quick RFC follow-up re: soft-shed proxy for public endpoints. Idea: per-client 'grace credits' stored locally at edge proxy + behavioral dampening (probation score) before escalating to hard throttle. Want to capture tradeoffs and contract with quota/ingress.

Mike: +1. Need clean interface: Proxy issues 'soft-credits' token consumption, calling QuotaService only on refill/overdraft. Still must support multi-region clients.

Jen: latency concern. Suggest: local cache w/ lease TTL + background reconcile. if miss -> allow short optimistic allowance (e.g., 1 req) while async check. That avoids blocking on central stores.

Kai: what about ephemeral clients? If many unique client IDs we risk state explosion. Proposal: LRU by request-count, and a 'stateless' fallback: rate-limit by fingerprint hashed bucket.

Samir: penalty scoring idea: score = max(0, base + alpha*burst - beta*goodBehavior). On score>=threshold -> elevated probation, reduce credit refill rate. Example pseudo:

```
score_t+1 = 0.9*score_t + 1.5*(burst_count/10) - 0.1*(sustained_successful_calls)
```

Also propose exponential backoff in refill.

Olivia: config sketch (edge proxy):

```
soft_shed:
  cache_ttl_s: 8
  initial_credits: 5
  refill_rate_per_min: 2
  probation_threshold: 10
  eviction_policy: lru, max_entries: 100k
```

We should make these tunable per-route/model.

Mike: ops concern: telemetry cardinality. Don't emit per-client metrics by default — emit sampled summaries + histograms. We can tag high-probation clients for audits.

Jen: rollout plan: feature-flag per route, start with internal-only, canary with 5% external, collect false-positive rate from eval prompts.

Kai: A few edge-cases: 1) shared API keys across tenants -> need tenant-level override, 2) bursty legit traffic (cron jobs) -> route white-list + scheduled credits.

Samir: security note: must authenticate client ID at ingress; don't trust X-Forwarded-* headers for public endpoints.

Olivia: perf bench request: @Mike can you run a microbenchmark comparing: central sync check vs local optimistic + async reconcile (p95 latency budget 30ms)? Also add memory footprint sim for 100k unique ids.

Mike: on it. Will push results in #eng-infra.

deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging (soft-shed-proxy v0.7) at 1745010200 :rocket:

Jen: next steps: formalize interface: (A) credit API (Reserve/Refund/Query), (B) probation event contract, (C) telemetry spec. I'll draft a follow-up RFC.

Olivia: thanks all. tagging for review: @Samir @Kai @Mike. I'll collect notes and open the RFC PR.
